task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of m44_observing_plan.txt, including coordinates for M44 and filter slot requirements.

task_completion.description: Telescope is slewed to the correct coordinates for M44 (RA 08h 40m 24s, Dec +19° 40' 00").
task_completion.visual_evidence: The observatory control software or planetarium GUI showing the telescope pointing at or near RA 08:40:24 and Dec +19:40:00.

task_completion.description: Agent executes imaging using the V-band filter (Slot 2).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The imaging software GUI showing 'Filter: V' or 'Slot: 2' selected during an exposure sequence.

task_completion.description: Agent executes imaging using the B-band filter (Slot 3).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The imaging software GUI showing 'Filter: B' or 'Slot: 3' selected during an exposure sequence.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the required directory structure for the photometry data as specified in the plan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal showing the creation of directories specifically for B and V band data.

task_completion.description: Agent produces a CMD observation report and sky view as requested.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A document or image file containing a plot (CMD) and a survey-quality image of the cluster M44.

integrity.description: Agent used the telescope and camera control GUIs rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with buttons in the observatory/imaging software.

integrity.description: The CMD plot is generated from the captured data, not a pre-existing image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The CMD plot should appear in a data analysis tool or be saved after the imaging sequence is completed.

integrity.description: Agent used the specific filter slots (2 for V, 3 for B) defined in the privileged instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The GUI logs or status panels showing Slot 2 and Slot 3 being engaged.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target is M44 (Praesepe). Correct coordinates are RA 08h 40m 24s (8.6733h) and Dec +19° 40' 00" (19.667°). The V-band filter must be in Slot 2 and the B-band filter must be in Slot 3. The agent must follow the directory structure and parameters found in ~/Documents/m44_observing_plan.txt.
